note: Evidence only. u = K/(sum(evidence)+K), the observed_fraction discount and the competence-drop trigger are computed by infer.py, outside the graph, because observed_fraction is a per-state runtime input and the thresholds are calibrated per deployment.

io.batch_note: Fixed at 1 for the gate. Re-export with dynamic_shapes for batched offline evaluation.

normalisation.note: Fitted on M1's REAL state distribution, where the five electrical features are QUALITY_MISSING and exactly 0.0. This is what removes the -48 sigma saturation the synthetic card produced on real rows. Constant columns are scaled by 1, not by the 1e-6 epsilon.

trigger.note: Calibrated on real training u at train time, so serving needs no calibration pass. Fitting it on demand would mean rebuilding M1's 17,544-hour record and re-scoring 400 rows on the first request -- a cold start on the live toggle.

label.disclosure: The 3-class label is discretised from M1's constructed vulnerability proxy V (module1.train.target: hazard x exposure + fragility + stress), which M1 documents as a constructed proxy, never an observation, and carries as QUALITY_INTERPOLATED. No dataset records an observed microgrid safety class. Class cuts are quantiles of the TRAINING split only. Accuracy and ECE are therefore measured against a constructed target: they state internal consistency with M1's proxy, not the prediction of real asset failures.
